w10_T4_001780: A mint press produced 105 medallions in its first run of the day. A supervisor mentioned that 50 employee badges also needed replacing, but that had nothing to do with the medallion count. A second press run turned every medallion into 3 medallions. A packaging line then turned each of those into 9 medallions for a promotional set. A wholesale order turned every medallion into 6 more for a nationwide distributor. A final specialty order turned each of those into 7 medallions for a collector's edition. How many medallions were produced after the collector's edition order?
w10_T4_001788: In the morning, Nadia had 212 trading stamps in her booklet, while her friend Owen had 95 stamps in his. By midday, Nadia used 18 stamps to redeem a small prize. In the afternoon, she spent 82 more stamps on a gift for her mom. That evening, she earned 29 more stamps from a bonus promotion. Right before the store closed, she lost 1 stamp that fell out of her booklet. A final loyalty bonus then turned every stamp she had left into 5 stamps. How many stamps did Nadia have after the loyalty bonus?
w10_T4_001792: A charity 5K race raised $234 from early registrations. A local business then donated $63 to the fund. A second business added $57 more. A runner rounded up their fee, contributing $9 extra. The race director mentioned that a dozen volunteers had helped set up the course that morning, taking about 90 minutes, or an hour and a half, to finish. A matching grant then turned every dollar raised into 9 dollars. How much money did the charity race raise after the matching grant?
w10_T4_001801: In the morning, a classroom had 192 sticks of chalk in the supply drawer. By midday, 105 sticks had been used across three classes. In the afternoon, 3 more sticks broke and were tossed out. The teacher mentioned a dozen new whiteboard markers were on order, though they hadn't arrived and had nothing to do with the chalk. That evening, 5 more sticks were used for an after-school tutoring session. Right before locking up, a supply closet restock turned every remaining stick into 7 sticks. How many sticks of chalk were in the drawer after the restock?
w10_T4_001802: In the morning, a bookstore had 142 novels on the bestseller table. By midday, a shipment added 43 more novels to the table. In the afternoon, another shipment brought 55 more novels. The manager noted that 30 bookmarks were also restocked that day, though that had nothing to do with the novel count. That evening, 41 more novels arrived from a local author's book signing. Right before closing, 105 novels were sold during a big promotion. How many novels were on the bestseller table after the promotion?
w10_T4_001803: Carlos had 202 comic books in his collection, while his friend Diego had 88 comics of his own. Carlos found 3 more comics in his attic. A comic convention swap then turned every comic he had into 9 comics. He also heard a vendor was selling a dozen collector pins nearby, though he didn't buy any and it didn't affect his comic count. A birthday gift added 40 more comics to his collection. Finally, a rare trade turned every comic into 6 comics. How many comics did Carlos have after the rare trade?
w10_T4_001807: In the morning, a food bank had 226 cans of vegetables in storage. By midday, a grocery store donated 51 more cans, and in the afternoon a school food drive added 38 more. A volunteer mentioned a dozen loaves of bread had also come in, though bread wasn't part of the can count. That evening, 159 cans were distributed to families in need, and later that night 118 more cans went to a shelter across town. Right before closing, a corporate donor gave 64 more cans, and a matching program then turned every can into 5 cans. How many cans of vegetables did the food bank have after the matching program?
w10_T4_001811: A candy factory produced 125 boxes of chocolates in a single batch. The factory manager noted that 20 broken machines needed repair, but that had nothing to do with the box count. A retooled line then turned every box into 9 boxes. A shipping error caused 776 boxes to be lost in transit. A make-good shipment then added 57 more boxes. A final bonus shipment, which the driver said took '120 minutes, or two hours' to deliver, added 66 more boxes. How many boxes of chocolates were there after the final bonus shipment?
w10_T4_001812: In the morning, Elena had $169 saved for a new bicycle, while her brother Theo had $85 saved for a skateboard. By midday, Elena spent $98 on bike accessories she needed first. That afternoon, a summer job bonus turned every dollar she had left into 7 dollars. In the evening, she earned $37 more from babysitting. Right before the bike shop closed, a loyalty discount turned every dollar into 9 dollars in store credit. How much store credit did Elena have after the loyalty discount was applied?
w10_T4_001816: Nina had 109 buttons in her sewing kit, while her sister Zoe had 200 buttons in her own kit. Nina used 64 buttons to finish a quilt project. A craft fair swap then turned every button she had left into 8 buttons, and a vendor's bulk trade turned each of those into 7 buttons. A second vendor's trade turned every button into 6 buttons, and her button count then doubled when a fabric shop offered a matching promotion. Finally, a closing sale turned every button into 3 buttons. How many buttons did Nina have after the closing sale?
w10_T4_001817: In the morning, Hannah had $37 saved in a shoebox. By midday, she earned $71 from selling old toys at a yard sale. In the afternoon, she earned $61 more from walking neighborhood dogs. She noticed a sale sign advertising a $15 discount at the toy store, but she didn't buy anything there. That evening, a birthday gift from her grandfather turned every dollar in her shoebox into 6 dollars. Right before bed, she added $73 more from her weekly allowance, and then found $11 more in her coat pocket. How much money did Hannah have in her shoebox after finding the money in her coat pocket?
w10_T4_001821: A pastry chef prepared 45 croissants for the morning batch. A second oven turned every croissant into 2 croissants for a catering order. The chef then split the croissants evenly among 6 delivery boxes and kept only one box for the shop display. A supplier delivered 58 more croissants for the afternoon rush, a delivery that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to arrive. A dessert festival order then turned every croissant into 8 croissants, and a final wholesale order turned each of those into 9 croissants. How many croissants were there after the final wholesale order?
w10_T4_001822: In the morning, a beekeeper had 176 jars of honey ready for sale. By midday, 26 more jars were filled from the second hive. In the afternoon, 65 more jars came from a third hive. That evening, a big honey festival order turned every jar into 4 jars for a bulk sale. Right after that, a farmers' market added 49 more jars to the stock. Before the day ended, a neighboring beekeeper contributed 48 more jars. How many jars of honey did the beekeeper have at the end of the day?
w10_T4_001824: A movie theater had 212 bags of popcorn in stock before the weekend rush. A vendor restocked with 48 more bags. During the first showing, 45 bags were sold. The manager mentioned a dozen soda cups had also been restocked, though that had nothing to do with popcorn. During the second showing, 104 bags were sold. During the third showing, 76 more bags were sold. After the last showing, 11 more bags were sold to a late-night crowd. How many bags of popcorn were left after the late-night crowd?
w10_T4_001826: In the morning, a toy drive had 118 stuffed animals collected. By midday, 87 stuffed animals were donated to a children's hospital. In the afternoon, a local business donated 54 more stuffed animals. That evening, 58 stuffed animals were sent to a shelter. Right after that, the remaining stuffed animals tripled when a toy company matched the donation drive. Before the night was over, 25 more were given to a school event, and 18 more went to a family shelter downtown. How many stuffed animals were left after the family shelter donation?
w10_T4_001829: In the morning, a farmer had 117 pumpkins in the field ready for harvest. He split them evenly into 3 equal wagon-loads and kept only one wagon-load to sell at his own stand. By afternoon, 6 pumpkins had gone soft and had to be discarded. That evening, 2 more pumpkins cracked during loading. Right before the farm stand closed, a neighbor dropped off 41 more pumpkins, a delivery that took '60 minutes, or a full hour' to complete. How many pumpkins did the farmer have at the farm stand after the neighbor's delivery?
w10_T4_001835: A school's recycling club collected 21 pounds of cans in the first week. The club advisor mentioned that 15 pounds of paper had also been recycled, but that was tracked separately from the cans. In the second week, the club collected 28 more pounds of cans. In the third week, they collected 51 more pounds. A regional recycling contest then turned every pound of cans into 6 pounds worth of credit. A bonus multiplier from the contest sponsor turned every pound of credit into 3 pounds. How many pounds of credit did the recycling club end up with?
w10_T4_001836: A small aquarium shop had 17 fish in a display tank for a spring sale. A new delivery turned every fish in the tank into 8 fish overall. The shop owner mentioned that 25 fish nets were also on sale, but that had nothing to do with the fish count. A sickness outbreak caused 116 fish to be moved to a quarantine tank. Then 3 more fish were sold to a customer. Finally, a rescue organization donated 38 more fish to the display tank. How many fish were in the display tank after the rescue donation?
w10_T4_001837: Priyanka had 124 trading cards in her deck-building collection, while her rival Sam had 300 cards in his. A convention trade turned every card she had into 5 cards. A second trade turned each of those into 7 cards. A tournament entry fee cost her 1075 cards. A rare misprint recall then took away 2077 more cards. A bonus round afterward turned every remaining card into 2 cards. How many cards did Priyanka have after the bonus round?
w10_T4_001851: In the morning, a bakery had 203 loaves of bread on the shelf. By midday, 13 loaves were sold to a local cafe. In the afternoon, 157 more loaves were sold during the lunch rush. That evening, a delivery brought in 67 more loaves. Right after, another batch added 32 more loaves fresh from the oven. A wholesale client then turned every loaf into 7 loaves for a large event order, but the client only picked up a portion, so the bakery split the loaves evenly into 3 equal batches and kept just one batch on the shelf. How many loaves of bread were left on the shelf?
w10_T4_001852: A stadium concession stand had 110 hot dogs ready before the game. A supplier delivery turned every hot dog into 7 hot dogs for the big game-day crowd. During the first quarter, 73 more hot dogs were grilled up, and during the second quarter, 9 more were prepared. At halftime, 18 more were grilled, a batch that took '30 minutes, or half an hour' to cook. After halftime, the stand split its hot dogs evenly between 2 serving windows and kept only one window's stock for the second half. During the fourth quarter, 18 more hot dogs were grilled for that window. How many hot dogs did that one serving window have after the fourth quarter?
w10_T4_001853: A school garden had 23 tomato plants growing in the spring. A frost damaged 2 plants beyond saving. A rabbit got into the garden and ate through 9 more plants. The number of healthy plants then doubled when the class started a new batch of seedlings, a project that took '120 minutes, or two hours' of planting time. A summer storm afterward destroyed 19 more plants. How many tomato plants were left after the storm?
w10_T4_001854: A school orchestra had 39 music stands set up for the spring concert. A donation drive turned every stand into 5 stands for the growing music program. During moving day, 147 stands were sent to a sister school, a move that took '180 minutes, or three hours' to complete. Then 9 more stands were damaged and discarded. A budget cut required giving away 32 more stands to another district. Finally, a matching grant turned every remaining stand into 3 stands. How many music stands did the orchestra have after the matching grant?
w10_T4_001857: A community garden had 70 sunflowers blooming in June. A strong wind knocked down 2 of them beyond recovery. A group of deer wandered through and trampled 19 more. A local nursery then donated 71 more sunflower plants to replace the losses. The gardeners split the sunflowers evenly into 3 equal garden beds and kept track of just one bed for the fall display. A late-season bloom then added 13 more sunflowers to that bed. How many sunflowers were in that garden bed by the end of the season?
w10_T4_001864: A candle shop made 115 candles for a fall market. A big wholesale order turned every candle into 6 candles. A second order turned each of those into 3 candles. A crafting workshop then added 3 more handmade candles to the batch, all packed within '60 minutes, or one hour' before the truck arrived. A holiday order then turned every candle into 4 candles. A final specialty order turned each of those into 3 candles. How many candles did the shop have after the final specialty order?
